summary: Planning-only split of I01c into three pending B1 children: real PostgreSQL/Flyway/jOOQ persistence and generation; Spring configuration/health/writer ownership and fencing; real application image/lifecycle qualification. I01c is in-progress and retains its original outcome/checks for a final combined qualification after all children. No product, build, runner, permissions or UI files changed; no application behavior or release gate is claimed passing.
selectionReason: The clean master checkout matches the supplied startCommit and state is active/authorized under D-304. No findings or due capability reviews exist; I01a and I01b are implemented and I01c depends only on I01a, so the supplied earliest-ready implementation selection is correct. The actual server has only a JVM module/classpath test, with no Spring runtime, migrations, generation or image. Building and fault-qualifying all three independently testable infrastructure layers would be oversized for one bounded unit. This pre-coding split preserves the complete I01c obligation, establishes fresh-session implementation boundaries and leaves I01d-I36 unchanged rather than skipping ahead or declaring partial code complete.

children.I01c2: Real Spring service/configuration/secret-file/health contracts, advisory ownership plus persisted epoch transaction fencing and DB-loss/recovery/two-writer tests.
children.I01c3: Digest-pinned actual application image with service and migration entrypoints, image-level lifecycle/failure/shutdown tests and reproducible local commands/cleanup.

The outer I01 parent still qualifies all six original children before I02.
planning.reviewBoundary: All descendants inherit B1; there is no new child review. Independent B1 review remains after I01-I04 and all descendants are implemented. Configuration, file secrets, schema compatibility, live/ready health, single-writer advisory ownership, persisted epoch fencing and DB reacquisition are implemented/tested in I01c2, then exercised from the actual image in I01c3.

Digest-pinned packaging, same-image explicit migration, bounded SIGTERM/restart and owned-resource cleanup are assigned to I01c3. Each layer retains exact commands/versions and honest not-yet-implemented worker status.

The unchanged I01c parent checks the integrated clean build, generation, migrations, service and image commands after children; I01 then checks the normal-APK/environment interfaces together. Later account/gameplay/inbox/outbox/notifications, E2E Compose ownership and amd64/arm64 release qualification are not pulled forward or omitted.
